---
title: "PEX: Patient Experience Survey"
description: "Information on peoples' experiences of and access and barriers to healthcare services including GPs, specialists, dental professionals, hospitals, and emergency departments."
---

Information on peoples' experiences of and access and barriers to healthcare services including GPs, specialists, dental professionals, hospitals, and emergency departments.

*Describes health-service experience variables, survey scope, weighting and file structure.*
